w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Redactor: Go quiet — starve the redaction. It redacts the loudest thing first, and the handles point a full round before the redaction lands. Go quiet for two turns and its attacks come thin; a third quiet turn starves it out of the fight. (Striking feeds it — every wound gets un-written.) (Zoe lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Gavel is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (24/14/8), with 6 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 59 → 24 · capped · Craft 15 · Talk 13 · Explore 54 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."

◈ Paisley Powell walks out of the light alone, which is how they walked in — and the audience, which came to be entertained, leaves humming the village's name. The village endures, loved and unbeholden, and the lights stay warm behind them.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,318 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.

✨ CAPSTONE: Apex Bow. The last thing the old world ever built right. It doesn't miss. Neither do you. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
